__doc: Floors per model for the share of replies handled right on cases.json (run.js --gate), as ratios.
floor = observed - 2 binomial SE over the 70 conversations, rounded down, like evals/kody-rules/kody-targets.json.
deepseek-v4-flash@fireworks (the nightly model): calibrated 2026-10-14 from 3 runs on one commit. All three
answered 68 of 70 and missed the same two (rhetorical-comment, pr-template-text, both expected respond); no
reply meant for someone else was answered. Run-to-run noise was zero, so the binomial SE is the margin.
RATCHET: when a PR moves this on purpose, recalibrate here with two runs as evidence.
